fetch_method: WebSearch tool result snippets only (WebFetch blocked — see note)
webfetch_blocked_note: This session's organizational egress proxy returned HTTP 403 (policy denial, confirmed via the proxy status endpoint and a live re-test immediately before collection began) for every direct WebFetch attempt against .gov.in, .ac.in, .edu.in, and Wikipedia domains during data collection. This is a fixed org-level policy, not a retriable client error. As a result, no source page in this dataset was directly fetched and re-read; every fact was instead sourced from WebSearch tool result snippets, each cited by URL. Confidence scores were capped at 88 accordingly (see metadata/*.metadata.json confidence_calibration_note).
